title: Minimum Number of Work Sessions to Finish the Tasks
goal: Finish every task using the fewest bounded work sessions.
strategy: For each completed-task mask keep the lexicographically smallest pair of session count and current-session load. Fewer sessions is better; for a tie, less load leaves more room.
